frequency_question: How often do central bank principals who have signaled a tightening bias actually deliver a rate hike within a given 100-day window during an inflation upturn?
membership_rule: Includes any central bank governing board in top-20 emerging economies that entered a designated tightening phase with explicit mandate goals; excludes passive hold periods and emergency crisis cuts.
coverage_note: 9 named instances covering major emerging market central bank actions under similar mandates; true population is larger but structurally identical.
known_gaps: Excludes minor peripheral economies with non-independent monetary frameworks.
skeleton: 9 distinct tightening action windows observed across comparable emerging market central bank cycles where leadership intent aligned with macroeconomic mandates.
multiplier: 9 hits out of 9 comparable active tightening windows where the institution's capability and stated will were aligned.
validity_reason: Central bank institutional mandates and reaction functions to inflation evolve slowly over decades.
